comment: Radio FM play a song called "Cry My Eyes Out" by The Rockets. It sounds just like <¤CBand.name>'s <¤calbum.name>. It's almost like they stole your song!
name: Radio
Headline: Copyright Infringement
question: What to do?

comment: Judge Griffin rules that "Cry My Eyes Out" by The Rockets has nothing in common with <¤calbum.name> and that your claims are unreasonable.\n\t"Anyone with ears can tell they're different melodies," he declares.

Judge Griffin rules that The Rockets are guilty of song theft in the first degree.\n\tAll royalties ($30 000) from "Cry My Eyes Out" shall be paid to <¤CBand.name>.\n\tThe Rockets are sentenced to one month's conditional incarceration.

Sergey wants to know why Nadia's career is going nowhere.\n\tHe doesn't want to be rough with you, but he just might unless things start moving.\n\tNadia is going to be a star and be on TV, can you get it into your head?

You can train your artists to play their instruments or sing, do live concerts or interviews. You can also make them look and perform better through physical training.\n\tClick on a portrait to find a list of actions.

Sergey is furious that you would treat his daughter so poorly.\n\tShe's a princess, can't you see? How could you let her become so sad? No trouble should be allowed to put wrinkles on her beautiful skin!
Sergey is very happy that Nadia seems to be enjoying herself with her new career.\n\tYou better keep it like that, because daddy does not like to see his angel sad.

Sergey Spektor is very disappointed with the band's performance at the last show.\n\tIf the band can't perform a good show, then how is Sergey's beloved daughter ever going to be a star?\n\tYou're the manager so you sort it out!

Sergey Spektor congratulates you on the great success of your latest concert.\n\tHe thinks you should keep doing shows like that, because if the band doesn't perform well on stage, how is Nadia ever going to be a star?
In any business, doing nothing is a certain road to failure, Sergey explains as he criticizes your passivity.\n\tYou better take action or face the consequences.
Sergey is furious about the poor publicity. Don't you see? An artist needs good PR and lots of it!\n\tYou better start working the media, or else
Sergey is glad that the media is finally taking interest in his daughter's efforts. He holds you responsible for their continued attention.
Your recklessness with Sergey's money has attracted his attention. He orders you to spend his funds wisely, or he'll have to take action.

<Missionvar.ScaredNewMusician.name> is worried about <¤Cband.name>'s connection to organised crime. {X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<Missionvar.ScaredNewMusician.gender>]} doesn't want to get into trouble with the law and thinks about leaving the band.

All <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name>'s talk about the Mafia offends Nadia. Nadia explains to {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.gender>, #Object:1]} that her father is a respected businessman who would rather die than engage in criminal activity.\n\tWhen <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.firstname> persists, Nadia responds with a physical retort, making matters worse.

<Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name> doesn't show up for practice all day. It happens again the next morning and nobody seems to know why.\n\tAfter a few days, you get the awkward feeling that you have seen <Missionvar.ScaredNewmusician.name> for the last time.

<¤CRealMusician.name> is very disappointed with the demo recording.\n\t{X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} thinks that Nadia's poor performance ruined a perfectly good demo. \n\t{X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<¤CRealMusician.gender>]} finds it hard to believe that <¤Cband.name> has a future with Nadia in it.

Nadia is furious that you would print a record cover without her on it.
	She's the star! All stars appear on their record covers! You just don't get it.
	Nadia won't work with you again ever and before she leaves, she warns you that her father won't be happy.
	Not happy at all.

TV24 are doing a big show called Stars of Cheese, sponsored by Mortensen Dairy, as promotion for their new Star Cheese spread (cheese with a chocolate taste for the younger generation).\n\tThey want <¤cband.name> to appear as the cheese-headliner. No pay, but it's a TV gig plus a lifetime's supply of Star Cheese.

The cheese gig was OK and Nadia is overjoyed. Now she is a star in her own right, being on TV was all she ever wanted.
	As a bonus, she made out with the producer in a broom closet after the show.
	Proud father Sergey Spektor pats you on the back and says it's a good thing you didn't screw up.
	You are always welcome to see him, should you ever need anything. Anything at all.
Nadia is very upset that you would give somebody else presents without giving her anything.\n\tDo you consider her less important than other band members?
Nadia is disappointed with you. You send other band members out of town, but she can't go?\n\tDon't you think she works as hard as the other members of the band?

On a recent visit to the night club Mirror Ball, Nadia runs into Zer0 Magazine reporter Andy Fairlane. They get along really well, it seems.\n\tThe next day Nadia wears a turtle neck to practice and loves being in pop.

Nadia is in an especially sour mood this morning and says she hates the whole pop-star deal. When asked what's bugging her, she at first won't tell.\n\tLater, she explains that she almost snogged TV24-reporter Steve at Mirror Ball last night, but some obnoxious fans got in the way and Steve split.

There's a big tumult in the practice room as Nadia is trying to claw <tmp.name>'s eyes out.\n\tAfter being separated, Nadia explains that <tmp.name> doesn't like her and thinks she has no talent.\n\tNadia also elaborates on <tmp.name>'s personal qualities and what she should have her father do to {X;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<tmp.gender>]}.
The show is unexpectedly good and the audience stays for the first few songs.\n\tApparently someone secretly disconnected Nadia's mike. She doesn't notice and no one tells her.
Just back from her absence, Nadia is anxious to set foot on stage and demands that you find her a gig right away!
Nadia finds a suitcase full of money at her dad's house.\n\tShe promises her father won't miss it and says she thinks the money should be used for the benefit of her own career.

Nadia has a creative proposition. She says that she doesn't really think <tmp.name> adds to <¤Cband.name>'s music.\n\tShe says the band would probably do a lot better without {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<tmp.gender>, #Object:1]}.

Nadia is ripping apart the practice room. Instruments and gear are flying overhead as the rest of the band hides.\n\tNadia is hysterical because <tmp.name> is too happy! She thinks {x;Pron;S3;[#Gender:<tmp.gender>]} is an insensitive moron who should consider others before grinning and singing.
Nadia feels not all of the band has as much musical skill as herself.\n\tShe suggests you get rid of <tmp.name>, whom she feels is the weakest link in <¤Cband.name>.

Nadia, such an innocent little girl, leaves the band because you could not keep her happy.\n\tThis is a complete failure and you know how Sergey feels about failing.\n\tYou should probably start running.
You're out of cash, and there's no hope in Sergey giving you more.

Sergey's patience is tried. You've been given plenty of chances, but you still failed!\n\tSergey does not accept failure. You have let him down and, worse, you have let his beloved daughter down.\n\tSergey suggests you leave Rock City and never come back.
Try again and make sure to give the child plenty of gifts to keep her happy.
Start over and spend your money more wisely. Make sure to train Nadia plenty before recording and playing live.\n\tAnd try not to think about what Sergey might do to you
Try again, and make sure to give Nadia singing lessons.
Want to be famous? A music video on TV is a great way to make you music known to the public. Choose a storyboard to suit your budget and start shooting!
So? All Nadia wanted was to be on TV, but when you finally get the offer you say no?
The Rockets' manager says <¤CBand.name> stole the song and you can look for compensation where the sun don't shine.
Er, you fired Nadia? The general idea was for her to be in the band. Don't expect any understanding from Sergey after such a stupid act. Firing his daughter from the band. Duh!
Try again and don't fire the main character this time.
The Rockets agree to give you part of the earnings from "Cry My Eyes Out" to avoid court. They offer you $15.000.
